meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 它读取仓库里全部未关闭的 issue 和 PR,每条各开一个后台子任务分析,把带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告写入 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录。全程只读,不在 GitHub 上做任何操作。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等词时触发,随后接管整个仓库的未关闭 issue 与 PR 分析。

howto.what_en: It reads every open issue and PR in the repo, spawns one background subagent per item, and writes evidence-backed reports (each claim needs a GitHub permalink) into /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'; it then covers all open issues and PRs in the repo.
